title: Dysregulation of epithelial differentiation architecture underlies field cancerization in head and neck cancer.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) has exceptionally high recurrence rates, exceeding 50%, contributing to mortality and morbidity.
